tour_trim.message: Drag across the timeline, or drag its edges. While playing, I sets the start and O the end.

tour_edit.message: Cut leaves a part out; Caption puts words on the picture. Choose an edit to change it. Undo is always there.

tour_sound.message: Change the volume, cut the silent parts, and, where the browser can, make captions from what is said.

tour_mode.message: All tools adds layers, music, slides, chapters, zooms, blur, backgrounds and more.

tour_export.message: Choose a format and export. Everything is made on your device; nothing is uploaded.

speech_not_here.message: Captions from speech aren't available in this browser. You can still type captions with Caption.

translate_not_here.message: Translating captions isn't available in this browser. You can add another language from a subtitle file below.

guide_translate_not_here.message: Translating isn't available in this browser

template_bug_tip.message: A GIF with your clicks shown, to show a problem

template_tutorial_tip.message: An MP4 with intro and outro slides, a first chapter and subtitles

template_social_tip.message: Upright MP4 with big captions in the middle, word by word

template_bug_done.message: Set up as a bug report: a GIF, with your clicks shown. Press B to blur anything private.

template_tutorial_done.message: Set up as a tutorial: MP4, intro and outro slides, a first chapter and subtitles. Add captions with T, or from speech.

template_social_done.message: Set up as a social clip: upright MP4, big captions word by word. Background music is in Sound.

check_captions_animation.message: Captions are set to subtitles only, and GIF and WebP have no subtitles, so this one will have no captions.

check_subs_off.message: Your other subtitle languages aren't added: turn on Add to MP4 and WebM as subtitles to include them.

check_music_loud.message: The music is loud and doesn't get quieter when someone speaks, so it may drown out the voice.

check_muted.message: Sound is turned off for this export.

check_big.message: The file may be as large as $1.

recover_export.message: Your last export of this recording didn't finish.

recover_join.message: Joining clips didn't finish last time.

recover_join_go.message: Put it back as it was

vo_tip.message: Talk over the video while it plays from the playhead; your voice is added as a voiceover

vo_started.message: Recording your voice. Stop, or pause the video, to finish.

vo_added.message: Voiceover added. It's in the edits, with its own volume.

vo_no_mic.message: The microphone isn't available. Allow it for Captode in the browser's site settings, then try again.

vo_hint.message: Drag its bar to move it, or its ends to shorten it. Split it at the playhead to remove a part.

au_clean_hint.message: Quieter between words, where only the room is heard

au_level_hint.message: Loud and quiet speech brought closer together

zoom_follow_hint.message: Moves with where the pointer was while recording

zoom_follow_tip.message: One zoom over the whole video that follows where the pointer goes

zoom_follow_added.message: Added a zoom that follows the pointer. Change how far it zooms in its settings.

fillers_tip.message: Find “um” and “uh” in the captions, hear each one, and cut those you choose

fillers_none.message: No filler words found in the captions.

fillers_hint.message: Where each is said is estimated from its caption, so listen first and untick any that aren't right.

fillers_done.message: Cut $1 filler words. Undo brings them back.

several_tip.message: Several files from these edits at once: other formats and shapes, made in the background

several_hint.message: Each is made in the background, one after another, with these edits.

hist_tip.message: History: every change, to go back several at once
